body: Mukha Abhyanga is a specialised Ayurvedic facial massage that uses herbalised oils (tailam) selected for your skin constitution. Precise, rhythmic strokes target key marma (vital energy) points across the face, neck and shoulders to stimulate circulation, improve lymphatic drainage and help the skin deeply absorb herbal nutrients.
It is a deeply relaxing, soothing 30-minute touch session — a warm oil application followed by synchronized friction and pressure strokes that induce mental tranquility and a meditative state.

Visible reduction in dark shades and puffiness
Enhanced blood flow giving a natural blush

treatments.title: Vyanga Care (Pigmentation)
treatments.description: Targeted treatment for facial pigmentation. Requires a few sessions, practitioner consultation and herbal supplements.
body: In Ayurveda, melasma and facial hyperpigmentation are called 'Vyanga', caused mainly by an imbalance of Bhrajaka Pitta (which governs skin colour) combined with aggravated Vata. This therapy works on deep-tissue melanin, so internal herbal guidelines, diet and multiple progressive sessions are part of the protocol.

It begins with a clinical consultation and a customised facial layout — deep exfoliation with herbal powders, Mukha Abhyangam with pitta-reducing oil, mild facial steam, and targeted herbal pastes (lepa). The herbal pastes may tingle or feel warm as they promote cellular turnover.
benefits: Gradual lightening of dark spots, melasma and hyperpigmentation patches
A more uniform and even skin tone
Long-term prevention of new spots by balancing systemic heat

treatments.title: Ayurvedic Pimple Care
treatments.sanskritName: युवान पिडक चिकित्सा · Yuvana Pidaka Chikitsa
treatments.description: Personalised acne and pimple care protocol. Requires a few sessions, practitioner consultation and herbal supplements.
body: Acne and pimples are classified as 'Yuvana Pidaka' in Ayurveda, stemming from vitiated Rakta Dhatu (blood tissue) and aggravated Kapha and Pitta. This protocol targets the root cause — sebum overproduction and systemic inflammation — rather than just the surface.

It includes expert consultation and dietary advice, gentle herbal steam (Svedana) to open clogged pores, a deep cleanse with anti-microbial herbal powder (Neem, Tulsi), and cooling anti-inflammatory herbal masks. Expect a few sessions to see improvement.
benefits: Visibly reduced inflammation, redness and swelling of active breakouts
Regulated sebum production without drying the skin

The face is treated with warm poultices or pastes of this rich, nutrient-dense rice blend so the skin deeply absorbs proteins, vitamins and minerals.

The treatment also includes cleansing, herbal bleaching, a herbal face scrub, an oil massage of the face and neck, and a face pack with herbs such as Rakthachandanam and Manjistha — an intensely rich, comforting 90-minute ritual.

treatments.title: Njavara Kizhi — Full Body
treatments.sanskritName: षष्टिक शालि पिण्ड स्वेद · Shashtika Shali Pinda Sweda
treatments.description: Ayurvedic oil application followed by milk-njavara kizhi over the full body. Strengthens joints and muscles and rejuvenates the body. A 15-minute consultation is mandatory before this therapy.

Over a course of sessions it builds stronger muscles and joints, making it especially valuable for seniors. A 15-minute consultation is required first.

It opens with a deep, nourishing scalp and hair oil massage, followed by Thala Pothichil, a scalp packing with a thick customised herbal paste of herbs such as Amalaki and Hibiscus processed in buttermilk, wrapped securely with natural leaves. treatments.title: Netra Tarpanam (Eye Rejuvenation)
treatments.description: A deeply nourishing eye therapy where warm medicated ghee is pooled over the eyes within a dough well. Relieves digital eye strain, dry eyes and fatigue. Done over a consecutive-day course with strict rest. Cannot be booked online — send an enquiry or book a free consultation first.
body: Netra Tarpanam, also known as Akshi Tarpana, is a deeply nourishing eye therapy in which small wells of black-gram dough are built around each eye socket and filled with warm medicated ghee, such as Triphala ghee, until it gently covers the eyes. As you slowly open and close your eyes, the ghee coats, lubricates and cleanses the eyes, the surrounding muscles and the nerves around them.

The therapy is carried out as a consecutive-day course with strict rest. During treatment, opening the eyes feels like a warm bath and vision turns temporarily golden and blurry; afterwards the eyes are wiped and may feel hazy with brief mild burning, so sunglasses, eye rest and reduced screen time are advised.
benefits: Deeply lubricates the eyes, helping as a remedy for dry-eye syndrome
Nourishes the optical nerves and improves clarity

Once the body is prepared, customised herbal compounds are used to induce controlled purgation that deeply cleanses the liver, gallbladder and small intestine, restoring balance from within.

treatments.description: A fully personalised postpartum recovery programme (Sutika Paricharya) combining Abhyangam, Kizhi, Kashaya Dhaara, Mukha Lepam, Sirodhara and Udara Veshtanam (abdominal wrapping). Tailored to your delivery type and breastfeeding needs after a free pre-package consultation. Enquiry only.
body: The Post-Delivery Care Package, traditionally known as Sutika Paricharya, is a fully personalised postpartum recovery programme spanning roughly the forty-five-day postpartum period. It is designed to nurture and restore the mother after childbirth, combining several core therapies that are tailored to her delivery type and breastfeeding needs.

During childbirth, a sudden emptiness in the pelvic cavity disturbs Vata Dosha, the digestive fire (Agni) weakens, and the body's tissues (Dhatus) are depleted. Left unmanaged, this imbalance can lead to chronic back pain, joint weakness, digestive issues, fatigue and postpartum anxiety — this care helps you heal correctly from the start.

Following a free pre-package consultation with the Ayurvedic doctor, the programme draws on customised core therapies including Abhyangam (oil massage), Kizhi (herbal poultice), Kashaya Dhaara (herbal decoction pouring), Mukha Lepam (herbal face pack), Sirodhara (head pouring) and Udara Veshtanam (abdominal wrapping). These are not all given on the same day; they are sequenced and tailored to support your recovery.

No two births are identical. A natural delivery has different immediate needs to a Cesarean section, where deep abdominal massage must wait until the incision heals. Your constitution (Prakriti), current imbalances (Vikriti), digestive strength and lactation needs are unique, so the oils, herbs, therapy durations and dietary guidance are customised to you.

Before starting, you'll have a free Pre-Package Consultation with our Ayurvedic Vaidya, which assesses your delivery type and any complications, your current vitals and healing progress, and your digestive capacity — ensuring every therapy is safely timed for you and your nursing infant.
benefits: Aids uterine involution and tones the abdominal muscles
Relieves lower backache, shoulder tension and joint pain
Calms the nervous system, eases exhaustion and promotes deep, restorative sleep
Boosts digestive fire and supports healthy weight management
Enhances breast-milk quality and quantity while boosting immunity for mother and child
